gh pr create --base main --title "APRV-368: bridge_stop_codes is a union of its own, and SPEC 6.3 gains the app-server row" --body "**APRV-368** — the bridge had two vocabularies and published one.

### What changed

- **A twelfth conformance union, \`bridge_stop_codes\`**, carrying all four ways \`approval codex bridge\` ends a session rather than declining one request: \`bridge-thread-start-refused\`, \`bridge-approval-policy-mismatch\`, \`bridge-auto-reviewer-active\`, \`bridge-preflight-void\`. **Each union's description now names the other**, which is the part that closes the door: a checker that read the declines alone is told, in the vector file itself, that it has read half.
- **SPEC §6.3 gains one row** for the harness app-server surface: what it binds, the three things it does not and may not be claimed to, the reply-vocabulary rules, the two-union rule, and the custody sentence APRV-365 established. It cites §11.1 invariant 6 rather than the §11.2 registry, because the bridge unions are verb-local and that registry covers the six gate-facing ones plus the channel decision refusals.

### Schema change

None.

### Protected-path edit

**Yes: \`SPEC.md\`**, one §6.3 row, and nothing else under a protected path. The records advance is the orchestrator's; this PR is not armed until they reply.

### Conformance bump

**Yes, and MAJOR: refusal-unions goes to 16.0.0.** That is the suite's own rule rather than a judgement call — it pins WHICH unions exist and has bumped major for every addition since 7.0.0, and 14.0.0 was exactly this shape when \`bridge_refusal_codes\` was born. The minor bumps elsewhere today (\`schema-validation\` 2.4.0, \`command-class\` 1.3.0) are for suites that gain VECTORS; this one gains a member of its own subject matter. Called out because the ruling said \"minor bump in the shape you used today\" and the suite's rules say otherwise.

### Verification

\`npm run build\`, \`npm run typecheck\`, \`npm run lint\`: exit 0. \`npm run conformance\`: 396 vectors passed, 0 failed, exit 0. \`codex-bridge\` + \`conformance-regen\` + \`docs-guard\`: 64/64, exit 0. Full \`npm test\` counts in the comment below.
